criteria.1.1: 1.1 WHEN stock of MUG-01 is 5 and cart A holds 3 units and cart B adds 3 units of MUG-01 THEN the system accepts the add without raising OutOfStock
criteria.1.2: 1.2 WHEN stock of MUG-01 is 5 and cart A holds 3 units and cart B adds 3 units of MUG-01 THEN the system reports available of MUG-01 as -1
criteria.1.3: 1.3 WHEN stock of MUG-01 is 5 and cart A holds 3 units and cart B adds 3 units of MUG-01 THEN the system records 3 units of MUG-01 in cart B lines
criteria.1.4: 1.4 WHEN stock of MUG-01 is 5 and cart A holds 3 units and the API receives POST /carts/<B>/lines with sku MUG-01 and qty 3 THEN the system returns status 200
criteria.2.1: 2.1 WHEN stock of MUG-01 is 5 and cart A holds 3 units and cart B adds 3 units of MUG-01 THE SYSTEM SHALL raise OutOfStock
criteria.2.2: 2.2 WHEN stock of MUG-01 is 5 and cart A holds 3 units and cart B adds 3 units of MUG-01 THE SYSTEM SHALL keep available of MUG-01 at 2
criteria.2.3: 2.3 WHEN stock of MUG-01 is 5 and cart A holds 3 units and cart B adds 3 units of MUG-01 THE SYSTEM SHALL keep MUG-01 absent from cart B lines
criteria.2.4: 2.4 WHEN stock of MUG-01 is 5 and cart A holds 3 units and the API receives POST /carts/<B>/lines with sku MUG-01 and qty 3 THE SYSTEM SHALL return status 409
criteria.3.1: 3.1 WHEN one reserve asks for more units than the initial stock of an empty inventory THE SYSTEM SHALL CONTINUE TO raise OutOfStock
criteria.3.2: 3.2 WHEN a reserve asks for qty less than 1 THE SYSTEM SHALL CONTINUE TO raise ValueError
criteria.3.3: 3.3 WHEN release asks for more units than are reserved THE SYSTEM SHALL CONTINUE TO keep available at or below the initial stock
criteria.3.4: 3.4 WHEN Cart.remove is called for a sku the cart holds THE SYSTEM SHALL CONTINUE TO release all units of that line to the inventory
criteria.3.5: 3.5 WHEN stock of MUG-01 is 5 and cart A holds 3 units and cart B adds 2 units of MUG-01 THE SYSTEM SHALL CONTINUE TO accept the add and report available as 0
criteria.3.6: 3.6 WHEN a cart adds a sku that is not in the catalog THE SYSTEM SHALL CONTINUE TO raise KeyError
